lead.event: US introduces advanced-chip export licensing rules affecting Singapore and regional data centres
lead.headline: US requires licences for advanced-chip exports to five economies
lead.blurb: The US Commerce Department’s interim final rule covers exports, re-exports and transfers of advanced semiconductors to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil. Existing data centre operators providing substantial computing capacity to China-headquartered companies have 90 days to obtain licences, with applications reviewed case by case. The US says the restrictions address a higher-than-normal risk of diversion to China, including Chinese firms’ remote access to regional computing power.

deals_control.event: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust agrees to acquire majority stake in AWS data-centre ventures
deals_control.headline: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust agrees to acquire 75% of AWS ventures
deals_control.blurb: The roughly US$5 billion deal covers 13 newly constructed powered shells across two AWS campuses in northern Indiana and Mississippi. AWS will retain 25% and lease the entire portfolio for an initial 12-year term, extendable to 32 years. Completion is expected in 2026.

deals_control.event: UOB sells Marina Collection condominium units
deals_control.headline: UOB sells 36 Marina Collection units for about S$103.5 million
deals_control.blurb: The 38 units UOB put up for sale on 14 November averaged $1,342 psf, and the sale was 1.7 times subscribed after more than 400 viewing groups. UOB’s damages award in its lawsuit against Lippo Marina Collection was raised to about S$82.4 million including interest.

deals_control.event: Hongkong Land reports capital recycling ahead of target and expands share buyback
deals_control.headline: Hongkong Land recycles US$4.2 billion ahead of target, lifts buyback to US$750 million
deals_control.blurb: About US$500 million of Southeast Asian property sales this year contributed to recycling against an initial target of at least US$4 billion by end-2027, with the disposals pending regulatory approvals. Hongkong Land added US$100 million to the buyback, with US$508.5 million repurchased to date, and extended it to 31 December 2027.

deals_control.event: Frasers Property FY2026 results, capital release and dividend proposal
deals_control.headline: Frasers Property reports S$300 million FY2026 profit and releases S$4.1 billion
deals_control.blurb: The board proposed a year-end dividend of 5 cents per share, up from 4.5 cents a year earlier. Capital releases included S$1.1 billion from portfolio optimisation, which brought Fraser Suites Singapore under full ownership, and proceeds from the sale of six Australian retail properties to fund residential projects.

earnings_guidance.event: AEM reports Q3 growth and raises FY2026 guidance
earnings_guidance.headline: AEM reports Q3 growth and raises FY2026 revenue guidance to S$680–705 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Q3 revenue was S$204.9 million, up 110.7% year on year, and EPS guidance is 30–33 cents. Growth was driven by Intel and its fabless AI/HPC customer, while the AMPS backlog exceeded S$450 million as of 11 November and is expected to ship over the next two to two-and-a-half quarters.

earnings_guidance.event: Metro Holdings reports 1HFY2027 results and strategic update
earnings_guidance.headline: Metro Holdings reports 1HFY2027 net profit of S$5.17 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: It re-entered Singapore’s residential market in May through a 30:70 joint venture with Wing Tai Holdings to develop a planned 330-unit Dunearn Road project. Metro plans to close its Paragon and Causeway Point stores when their leases expire, shifting to smaller, more flexible multi-concept stores.

earnings_guidance.event: Citi cuts target prices for DBS, UOB and OCBC
earnings_guidance.headline: Citi cuts DBS target to S$78, lowers UOB and OCBC targets
earnings_guidance.blurb: Citi lowered DBS's target to S$78 from S$80.3, UOB's to S$33.9 from S$35 and OCBC's to S$25.3 from S$26, while keeping a Buy rating on DBS and Sell ratings on UOB and OCBC. It cited uncertainty over US chip restrictions and credit risks in AI-related financing. CreditSights estimates data centre financing accounts for about 3% to 5% of the banks' total loans.

earnings_guidance.event: Analysts maintain Buy calls after Singtel H1 FY2027 results
earnings_guidance.headline: Analysts maintain Singtel buy calls after underlying profit rises 10%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Maybank Securities raised its target price to S$5.22, while DBS Group Research, RHB and CGS International kept theirs at S$5.46, S$5.40 and S$5.16. Underlying net profit rose 10 per cent to S$1.49 billion, and Singtel raised full-year OpCo Ebit growth guidance to mid-to-high single digits.

market_structure_policy.event: Geo Energy shares slide, then rebound after clarification on Indonesian mining policy
market_structure_policy.headline: Geo Energy shares fall 23%, then rebound almost 8% after mining policy clarification
market_structure_policy.blurb: In a 17 November clarification, the company said its Indonesian mining and logistics operations were normal and it had received no notice of new rules or directives. It said it already contributes more than 70% of profits to Indonesia through taxes, royalties and fees, while its permits remain valid until 10 January 2028 and 22 May 2030.

market_structure_policy.event: Simba admits spectrum misuse and director Richard Tan prepares to step down
market_structure_policy.headline: Simba admits spectrum breaches as Tan prepares to resign amid S$75 million fine risk
market_structure_policy.blurb: Simba Telecom will not contest IMDA's allegations, and president Richard Tan will resign as a director subject to regulatory approval. The investigation is ongoing, and IMDA has not confirmed findings. DBS Group Research estimates potential fines of up to about S$75 million and says IMDA may suspend Simba's spectrum rights.

macro_flows.event: Citi rates Singapore equities underweight and sets STI target
macro_flows.headline: Citi rates Singapore equities underweight, sets STI target at 5,325
macro_flows.blurb: The call applies for H1 2027, with Citi saying the index looks expensive against history and regional peers after falling over 12 per cent from its 5,801.96 peak on 4 September to 5,054.89 on 18 November. Citi names DBS its only bank pick with a buy rating and also recommends Sats, Singtel, Yangzijiang Shipbuilding and CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust.

macro_flows.event: URA reports October private-home sales rebound
macro_flows.headline: URA reports October new private-home sales rebound to 1,716 units
macro_flows.blurb: Sales were 5.8 times September’s 296 units but 29.2% below October 2025. Thomson Reserve led with 1,029 of its 1,268 units sold at a median of $2,865 psf.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: mm2 Asia reports H1 FY2027 results and debt repayment scheme progress
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: mm2 Asia reports S$106.57 million H1 loss as creditors back debt scheme
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Majority creditors approved a repayment scheme proposed by mm2 Asia and mm2 Entertainment on 4 November. It will be submitted to the court, while shareholders are to vote at an extraordinary general meeting in the second half of December as a white-knight investor conducts final due diligence.
